faults.fault: At 1.6x width the window does not gain product columns; the extra width is a blank smeared tan panel across the middle of the glass, and the $ price tags run off cut. A wider machine must show more bays behind the same glass.

At 1.5x height no new shelf rows appear; the added height went into blank body between window and push door with a smeared stripe band (decal_7/arrow texture stretched across the plain panel). A taller machine needs more product rows on the grid.
Panel texture smears and bands where the prop was enlarged: plain beige rectangle blotted over the window and coin area when widened, streaked arrow pattern down the body when heightened.
At 1.6x width the push door region is overlaid by the smeared blank panel, cutting the door texture; the delivery door should keep its width while the body widens around it.
Wireframe shows the window pane standing off in front of the body rather than sitting recessed behind the frame line.

wider_means: A wider vending machine has more product columns behind the same glass front, with the delivery door and coin mechanism keeping their width.
taller_means: A taller vending machine has more product rows on the shelf grid and a longer plain body between the window, the delivery door and the kick base — not a taller sign or a taller door.
